settings.name: all
settings.label: Show All General Head Fall Sections
settings.description: Shows or hides this section without changing any saved physics values.

settings.name: showHeadForwardSection
settings.label: Show Forward
settings.description: Show or hide the Head Forward controls.

settings.name: enabled
settings.label: Enable Forward
settings.description: Master switch for this section.

settings.name: forwardRegular
settings.label: Show Regular Forward Controls
settings.description: Shows or hides these controls without changing saved physics values.

settings.description: Shows or hides these controls without changing saved physics values.

settings.name: forwardImpact

settings.name: onDeath
settings.label: Head Forward - On Death
settings.description: Fire this lane when death starts.

settings.name: onGroundImpact
settings.label: Head Forward - On Impact
settings.description: Fire this lane when the body hits the ground.

settings.name: disableOnGround
settings.label: Head Forward - Disable On Ground
settings.description: Stop this lane once the body is considered on the ground.

settings.name: disableOnGroundDelay
settings.label: Head Forward - Disable On Ground Delay
settings.description: Delay before the on ground lockout becomes active.

settings.name: headKillOnDeathDelay
settings.label: Head Forward - Kill On Death Delay
settings.description: Delay before this lane is killed after death starts.

settings.name: directionMin
settings.label: Head Forward - Direction Min
settings.description: Minimum forward movement needed before the forward head lane is allowed to fire.

settings.name: forwardBackMin
settings.label: Head Forward - Forward/Back Min
settings.description: Minimum forward or backward impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: forwardBackMax
settings.label: Head Forward - Forward/Back Max
settings.description: Maximum forward or backward impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: leftRightMin
settings.label: Head Forward - Side Min
settings.description: Minimum left or right impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: leftRightMax
settings.label: Head Forward - Side Max
settings.description: Maximum left or right impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: upDownMin
settings.label: Head Forward - Up/Down Min
settings.description: Minimum vertical impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: upDownMax
settings.label: Head Forward - Up/Down Max
settings.description: Maximum vertical impulse value for this lane.

settings.name: chancePct
settings.label: Head Forward - Chance %
settings.description: Chance for this lane to fire when its trigger happens.

settings.name: radius
settings.label: Head Forward - Radius
settings.description: Impulse radius used for this lane.

settings.name: headTargetOffset
settings.label: Head Forward - Head Target Offset
settings.description: Moves the impulse point along the Neck to Head direction. Positive moves it higher, toward the top or front of the head. Negative moves it lower, back down toward the neck or deeper into the head.

settings.name: delaySec
settings.label: Head Forward - Delay
settings.description: Delay before the first impulse step in this lane.

settings.name: steps
settings.label: Head Forward - Steps
settings.description: Number of impulse steps used by this lane.

settings.name: stepDelay
settings.label: Head Forward - Step Delay
settings.description: Delay between impulse steps.

settings.name: rampMode
settings.label: Head Forward - Ramp Mode
settings.description: Shape used to scale the impulse across steps.

settings.name: enableRebound
settings.label: Enable Forward Rebound
settings.description: Master switch for the forward rebound lane.

settings.name: showReboundForwardSection
settings.label: Show Forward Rebound
settings.description: Show or hide the Head Forward Rebound controls.

settings.name: reboundRegular
settings.label: Show Regular Forward Rebound Controls
settings.description: Shows or hides these controls without changing saved physics values.

settings.name: reboundRequiresHeadImpulse
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - Wait For Head Impulse
settings.description: Only allow rebound after the main forward head impulse has fired.

settings.name: reboundOnImpact
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - On Impact
settings.description: Fire this lane when the body hits the ground.

settings.name: reboundUseNeckFoldGate
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - Use Neck Fold Gate
settings.description: Use the forward rebound detector. When off, this rebound lane falls back to Direction Min.

settings.name: reboundNeckFoldMin
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - Neck Fold Min
settings.description: How far the head probe must move forward before rebound can fire. 0 disables this gate.

settings.name: reboundNeckDropMin
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - Neck Drop Min
settings.description: How far the head probe must move downward before rebound can fire. 0 disables this gate.

settings.name: reboundKneeNearPct
settings.label: Head Forward Rebound - Knee Near %
settings.description: How much of the starting gap to the knees must be closed before rebound can fire. Lower is easier. 0 disables this gate.
